answer.reason: The verses tell of Nahash besieging Jabesh-gilead and demanding the right eyes of its men, and of his death and the kindness he had shown David.

clauses.english: encamped against Jabeshgilead and offered a covenant only if all their right eyes were thrust out
clauses.quote: On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes

clauses.english: showed kindness to David, and his son reigned in his stead when he died
clauses.quote: as his father shewed kindness unto me

doubts: 2SA 17:25 names a Nahash whose daughter Abigail is Amasa's mother's relation; this may be another man or the same, so it was left out.
The second clause joins his death and the kindness shown to David; the kindness is known only through David's words.
